usage: Used for a person or company that buys your products or services; it sounds natural in business and service settings.
Often refers to an ongoing business relationship, not just a one-time customer; common in sales, consulting, law, and agency work.
Can be used with verbs like 跟進, 維持, 服務, and 聯絡 when talking about client management.
More formal than talking about ordinary shoppers; for retail or casual shopping, people may also say 顧客.
